name: get_model_info
author: hprebar
title: Get model info
description: Overview of the SAP2000 model the bridge is attached to: file name and folder, lock state, present and database units, SAP2000 version, object counts (points, frames, areas) and optionally defined groups. Call it first: every script works in kN and m whatever the model's units. Read-only.
notes: OAPI: cSapModel.GetModelFilename/GetModelFilepath/GetModelIsLocked/GetPresentUnits/GetDatabaseUnits/GetVersion, cPointObj/cFrameObj/cAreaObj.GetNameList, cGroupDef.GetNameList. After a save GetModelFilename reports the .$sb working copy; the seed reports the .SDB.

includeGroups.description: Also list defined groups in the model
